El Niño Intensifies, Prompting Crop Warnings in India

The World Meteorological Organization and the UN have warned of a rapidly strengthening El Niño, increasing the likelihood of extreme weather events globally. In India, state governments are advising farmers to consider planting short-duration crops to mitigate potential impacts on agriculture. Concerns are particularly noted in Telangana, where water scarcity issues are also being raised.
